Coverage: POST /api/media/upload (401 no-auth, 400 invalid kind, 400 non-image content-type, 200 happy path returns {id,kind,url,size,content_type,storage_path}); GET /api/media/:id via Bearer header AND ?auth= query param returning the actual PNG bytes (magic \x89PNG verified); 401 without auth; 403 cross-user; 404 unknown id; DELETE soft-delete then GET returns 404. Attachments: PATCH /api/programs/:id/cover round-trips cover_media_id via GET, PATCH /api/teams/:id/logo returns logo_media_id, PATCH /api/teams/:id/players/:pid/photo stores photo_media_id on roster entry, PATCH /api/programs/:id/sessions/:week accepts photos[] (capped/stored) and drills[].media_id (round-trips through sanitiser). Storage init log 'Emergent object storage initialised' present in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log. Frontend Playwright: logged in as test1@test.com, program-cover MediaUpload renders on /programs/:id, JPG/PNG upload succeeds (toast 'Uploaded'), renders inside button with ?auth= src. Refreshing Dashboard shows cover thumbnail on the program card (direct in Dashboard.jsx, not MediaImage helper — expected). Team detail shows team-logo MediaUpload (upload OK, img rendered) plus one player-photo upload square per player row. Session view (/programs/:id/week/1) exposes media-upload-session-photo control. Amend Session → Add Custom drill form exposes media-upload-drill-media control.

issues: Team logo empty state uses same border/background as filled state; harder to spot on smaller screens — minor UX.

critical_code_review_comments: MediaUpload passes JWT in URL query (?auth=) — required for auth, acknowledged tradeoff. Tokens will appear in server access logs and browser history. Consider issuing a short-lived scoped media token instead of the full access JWT.

storage.py:_get returns raw bytes into memory then re-emits via FastAPI Response — for 200MB videos this doubles memory. Consider StreamingResponse with iter_content chunks from the upstream requests call.
server.py:483 download_media duplicates cookie/Bearer/query token extraction instead of calling get_current_user — acceptable but drifts from single source. Could be refactored into a helper.

MediaUpload component's remove (×) button has opacity-0 by default and only becomes visible on hover/focus; on touch devices there's no hover — users may not discover the remove control. Consider always-visible × on mobile.

SessionView drill-media replaces YouTube search only for custom drills that have media_id set — for very large videos there is no width/height constraint on <video>, could cause layout jumps. Consider aspect-video wrapper.
Dashboard.jsx builds img src inline with API+token instead of reusing MediaImage helper (DRY).
